en.t: The handwriting was indeed very immature.

units.source_text: 紫姬看了一定在想：十四岁的人不应该写得如此拙劣。

en.t: When Lady Murasaki saw it, she must have thought that someone of fourteen should not write so poorly.

units.source_text: 但她装作不见，默默不语。

en.t: But she pretended not to notice and remained silently quiet.

units.source_text: 若是别的女人之事，源氏一定私下在紫姬面前品长评短。

en.t: If it had concerned some other woman, Genji would certainly have made private comments about it in front of Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 但三公主身份攸关，不忍教她委屈。

en.t: But because Princess Three's rank was at stake, he could not bear to make her feel wronged.

units.source_text: 他只是安慰紫姬道：“你可以放心了。”

en.t: He merely comforted Lady Murasaki, saying, "You may set your mind at ease now."
